title: MOPO: Model-based Offline Policy Optimization

methods.one_paragraph_description: Learns an ensemble of N Gaussian probabilistic dynamics models on the offline data, then runs MBPO-style short (h-step) model rollouts from dataset states with a SAC policy, using a reward penalized by the uncertainty of the dynamics: r_tilde(s,a) = r_hat(s,a) - lambda * max_i ||Sigma_phi^i(s,a)||_F (maximum std of the ensemble). Policy is trained with SAC on a mix of real data and penalized model rollouts (Algorithm 2).
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: model-based offline RL (paper: 'we propose to modify the existing model-based RL methods by applying them with rewards artificially penalized by the uncertainty of the dynamics'; 'largely follows MBPO')
